text.tspan: WHAT CHANGED vs R41: the 1.80 m court-side balcony (43.2 m²) is gone. Circulation is now a 1.20 m corridor at the BACK (north) wall (26.2 m²), so every
wellness room is 4.70 m deep (was 4.10) and gets the court-side façade.
Net gain ≈ 17 m² of wellness space. Reception + lounge at the west end keeps a clear-glass view down to courts B4–B6; treatment rooms use frosted glass
on the court side; the quiet lounge is clear glass.
ARRIVAL: S1 (+3.50) opens straight onto the corridor; the west-wing bridge enters the reception. The east exit moves to the corridor end → new landing
+3.50 (x 22.2…23.6, y 28.3…30.1) → short stair to the catwalk +4.50 — the old landing at y 24.2…25.8 must move north.
DRAINS: sauna, plunge, rinse shower and WC sit against the corridor; pipes run in the 150 mm raised corridor floor and leave through the north façade into
external downpipes (no coring of the existing slab).
Still to check: HBOT/plunge loads (≤ 300 kg/m²) · 2 exits (S1 + bridge + east stair) · no lift.
